title: Tooling: 3.58× faster joint-frame product with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the historical positive-side audit spends substantial time in `scripts/audit_joint_frames.py:product`, which multiplies rational matrices entrywise with many intermediate `Fraction`s.

This PR clears denominators once per factor, multiplies with Python integers, and rebuilds canonical `Fraction`s. The product is entrywise equivalent. Only the source pin for `audit_joint_frames.py` changes inside `certificates/rank-product-core.json`.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12, five alternating fresh-process pairs of the positive-side stream gave median **26.143 → 7.302 s (3.58×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Positive-side experiment receipts stay fieldwise identical.

Package: `research/joint-frames-cleared-product/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/joint-frames-cleared-product/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/joint-frames-cleared-product/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-frames-cleared-product
python3.12 -I -B research/joint-frames-cleared-product/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_JOINT_FRAMES_CLEARED_PRODUCT positive_side_cases=12 random_cases=2500 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/joint-frames-cleared-product outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_POSITIVE_SIDE_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1217](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1217). No competing open PR on cleared-denominator `product` at refresh.
